gaps.explanation: The report itself prints two different nonmajor transfers-in figures. p4 Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds: Transfers in Road Fund 2,591,391 + Equipment Sinking Fund 17,811 + Nonmajor Funds 182,443 = 2,791,645 (Total). Detail has General 0 (idx 0 line on p6) + Road 2,591,391 (p7) + Equipment Sinking 17,811 (p8) + 'Nonmajor funds (combined)' 182,422 = 2,791,624, the 182,422 being the printed Total Nonmajor Funds transfers in on the p13 combining statement (p13 also prints 178,151 / 874,971 vs p4 178,152 / 874,972). The individual nonmajor columns on pp10-12 print Special Road 175,916 + Federal Drug Law Enforcement 2,235 + Federal Equitable Sharing 4,291 = 182,442 (and Special Road's own total line prints 176,916). 2,791,645 - 2,791,624 = 21 = 182,443 - 182,422. The detail line is the printed combining-statement total, so no line is missing or duplicated; the 21 is a difference inside the printed report (p4 vs p13; per-fund columns add to a third figure, 182,442), so it cannot be closed exactly with printed amounts.
